Young Kim highlights legislative priorities and community partnerships in recent social media posts
C. J. Dodge
Young Kim, U.S. Congresswoman representing California’s 40th district, shared updates on her legislative efforts and community engagement in a series of posts on July 21, 2026.
In a post published at 19:00 UTC, Kim highlighted her collaboration with local officials: "Great meeting with San Bernardino County Chairwoman Dawn Rowe! Excited for the year ahead & continuing our strong partnership to deliver real results for San Bernardino families! https://t.co/oGPUeY8Jdb".
Later that evening, at 20:00 UTC, she addressed issues affecting seniors: "Seniors deserve to enjoy retirement without unfair Medicare premiums eating into their hard-earned savings. That’s why I introduced the Medicare Premiums Reduction Act, which delivers up to $241/mo so our seniors on fixed income can afford the care they need.".
At 22:00 UTC, Kim reaffirmed her commitment to supporting future generations: "The American Dream belongs to all who are willing to work for it. I will keep fighting to create opportunities for our kids & grandkids to succeed in this great nation.".
Kim has represented California’s 40th District in Congress since replacing Gil Cisneros in 2021 and previously served in the California State Assembly from 2014 to 2016. Born in Incheon, South Korea, in 1962 and now residing in La Habra, she graduated from the University of Southern California with a BBA in 1985.
